setup.name: The scene
setup.text: It hasn't rained in weeks. (subject), (friend) and (third) decide to try the old rain dance their grandparents used to do, mostly for fun. They dance until they're dizzy. Three hours later it rains. Nobody can agree whether the dance did it. Everybody agrees to dance again next time, just in case.
